method: One request per 15 minutes reads the ENTIRE world's indexed news; we find our tickers inside it. Companies are matched on GDELT's entity-resolved organization names. Aliases that are ordinary English words (News, Gap, Fox, Apple) are tier `watch`: their counts require independent corroboration (ticker in headline, tight business theme, or a second title token) before entering a z-score.
limits: Article volume measures MEDIA attention, not investor attention. GDELT tone is lexicon-based and does not know that 'beat' is good in an earnings context. z-scores are withheld until 3 days of self-collected history exist.
